verdict.rationale: A live llms.txt file was confirmed at rocm.docs.amd.com/llms.txt with a 200 response, providing an agent-readable entry point into ROCm documentation, and the runtime probe confirms the docs surface is crawlable without a browser. Missing for 10: no evidence of per-page markdown/.md variants (404 on that probe), no OpenAPI/agent tool spec, and no confirmation that agent-oriented docs cover the MI355X product pages themselves rather than just ROCm software.
